findings.message: the file declares 'stability', which the loader does not read. Implement it, drop it, or write what it was saying as 'notes:', the one key every level admits.
field 'related' declares 'unique', which the loader does not read. Implement it, drop it, or write what it was saying as 'notes:', the one key every level admits.
type 'widgets' declares no 'folder:'. Say which folder holds its records.
type 'widgets' declares 'id.style: roman-numeral', which no id check reads. The styles the tool applies are 'mnemonic', 'numbered', 'slug'.
type 'widgets' declares 'index.order: newest-first', which the generator does not read. An index is written 'ascending', 'descending'.

type 'widgets' declares 'tier: experimental', and '_tiers.yaml' declares no such tier. Tier decides how a document behaves and is written into the frontmatter of every record of the type; the tiers are 'decided', 'normative', 'descriptive', 'procedural', 'observed'.
type 'widgets' declares 'export.sections: Summary' at fidelity 'gist', which nothing carries there. An export carries 'full', 'reference', 'summary'.

type 'widgets' declares 'export.sections: Provenance', and its 'sections:' block declares no such section. Name a section the type has, or add it. Selecting by key is what keeps the two declarations in step.

type 'widgets' declares 'export.fields: colour', and neither the type nor '_universal.yaml' declares such a field. Name a field a record carries, or 'title', which is a record's heading rather than its frontmatter.

type 'widgets' declares an 'export:' block and no 'version:' above 0. A consumer reads these files against that number, and moving it by hand is what says a reader written against the shape before it would now be wrong.
type 'widgets' declares 'export.parts:' and carries no 'parts:' block. Say where a record keeps the parts an export is to carry, or drop the entry.
type 'widgets' has a 206-character 'summary:'; the limit is 120. It is rendered as a table cell. The fuller account belongs on widgets.md.
type 'widgets' declares no 'goes-here:'. Say what a contributor has in hand when this type is the answer, in one line the taxonomy and the corpus index can be generated from.
type 'widgets' declares no 'lineage.prior-art:'. Name what the type is nearest to, or say that nothing established fits. Claiming an ancestor a type does not have is worse than admitting none.
field 'classification' draws its values from '$enums.sensitivity', and _enums.yaml declares no 'sensitivity'.
field 'tags' is 'type: list' and declares 'values:', which only an enum's range is read from. Declare it 'type: enum', or drop the values.
field 'related' declares 'mirrors-section: See also', and the type's 'sections:' block declares no such section. Name a section the type has, or add it.
field 'retention' has a required-when the schema cannot read: 'classification is personal'. Write it as 'other == value', 'other != value', or 'other in [a, b]'.
field 'retention' is 'type: string' and declares 'min-items:', which only a list's length is read against. Declare it 'type: list', or drop the floor.
field 'retention' is 'type: string' and declares 'min-records:', which is read against the entries of a list. Declare it 'type: list', or drop the floor.

rule 'widgets-are-blue' on type 'widgets' declares 'severity: warning' and nothing dispatches it. Give it an 'expr:', implement it as a rule class, or drop the severity and leave it declared as an intention.
rule 'widgets-have-an-owner': expected ')' closing 'present(' in 'present('owner''.
rule 'widgets-are-documented' has an expr but no severity. Say whether it fails a build or advises an author.
rule 'widgets-are-named' has an expr but no message: an author has to be told what to do about it.
type 'widgets' declares a 'versus:' against itself: a disambiguation has two sides.
